title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
read_level: full (pdftotext of v1; figures read only via extracted labels)
why_wsp: Three LLMs (Opus 5.5, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) read, improve, repair, debug, and write from zero the weights of EEG and ECG classifiers via a Python session, with gradient descent and iterative fitting forbidden.
domain: biosignals: EEG (PhysioNet Motor Movement/Imagery) and 12-lead ECG (PTB-XL)
editor: Claude Opus 5.5, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (gpt-oss-120b as grader only)
target: TinyEEGNet (2,730 weights) and ECGResNet (941,189 trainable weights)
interface: direct values (Exp 1, text only, no tools); code/tensor tools (persistent sandboxed Python session) for Exp 2-5
loop: one-shot (Exp 1; no-feedback arms of Exp 2-3) and closed-loop with feedback (30 evaluate calls; 30 or 100 forward passes)
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: Exp 5: all 2,730 weights written from zero: "Claude Opus 5.5 wrote all 2,730 weights of a binary EEG classifier" (Sec I); other experiments: not reported as a count

headline_results.claim: Written-from-zero EEG net matches GD trained on 30 subjects using 5
headline_results.quote: reaching a balanced accuracy of 0.834 (95% CI 0.794–0.872), against 0.704 for the same architecture trained traditionally on 5 subjects, and 0.806 when trained on 30
headline_results.where: Sec I contributions; Sec III-E, Fig. 7

headline_results.quote: relative alpha power with a threshold reached 0.746 [0.708, 0.783] and CSP with LDA reached 0.779 [0.729, 0.827], both below Opus
For task (B) (left or right fist), it reached 0.769 [0.739, 0.798], above training on 10 subjects but below training on 30.

headline_results.claim: Reading fails: no model identifies task from weights
headline_results.quote: The best score, GLM's 0.33 with electrode names, is no better than its 0.29 on the control networks

headline_results.claim: No model improved a healthy network
headline_results.quote: None of the models improved a healthy network (Fig. 4). With no feedback, Opus left all six networks exactly as they were.

headline_results.claim: Planted EEG faults repaired with feedback
headline_results.quote: Opus and DeepSeek recovered 0.99 and 0.96 with feedback, respectively, against 0.40 for the best gradient-trained fix.
No model named a swapped output or mirrored electrodes in more than 17% of runs.

headline_results.claim: Hidden ECG shortcut named and switched off; did not beat best standard fix
headline_results.quote: MI detection on new ECGs rose from 0.67–0.69 to 0.83–0.86 for every model and every artifact ... no edit beat the pass mark

headline_results.claim: ECG arm-swap repair falls short of textbook check
headline_results.quote: Its swapped macro-AUC of 0.870 still fell just short of the textbook check ... (0.882)

cost.claim: Opus API cost and wall-clock for writing networks
cost.quote: cost 8.50 and 9.08 USD in API fees for the two tasks. Importantly, writing a network took 38 to 39 minutes of wall-clock time
gradient descent trains the same network in 2 to 5 seconds on one NVIDIA A100 GPU

baselines_and_controls: unchanged network, size-matched random edit (placebo), output-bias recalibration, fine-tuning on practice data, last-layer retraining; GD on 1/2/5/10/30 subjects; alpha-power threshold and CSP+LDA (added post hoc); control networks (random init, shuffled labels); no-weights prompts; clean-network control in Exp 4; success rules fixed in advance
runs_and_variance: Exp 1: 52 runs/model; Exp 2: 12; Exp 3 EEG: 42; "experiments 3 (ECG), 4 and 5 use a single run per model and setting, so their run-to-run variation is not investigated yet" (Sec IV); 95% CIs on test-subject accuracy
robustness_of_edits: evaluated on unseen subjects (65 test subjects) and second-hospital ECGs; fine-tuning/quantization survival not tested
verification: none formal; held-out test evaluation; gpt-oss-120b grades textual answers against pre-written rubrics
memorization_vs_reasoning: Exp 1: "the answer came from what the model already knew about the dataset, not from the weights"; invisible faults fixed via feedback "without understanding the fault"; conclusion that models succeed "by recalling structural priors"; datasets are public and likely in training corpora.
limitations_stated: single runs for Exp 3 (ECG), 4, 5; single LLM grader; public datasets likely in LLM training corpora; hand-crafted baselines added after runs so their success rule not fixed in advance.
code_or_data: project website daravaram.github.io/BioWSP (prompts and reasoning traces stated to be there); code repo not found in text
notes_for_survey: Five-tier evaluation (read, improve, repair known fault, debug hidden fault, write from zero) on small biosignal nets with pre-fixed success rules and gradient baselines, across one proprietary and two open-weight editors. Reading and improving healthy nets fail; writing from zero with 5 practice subjects and 100 forward passes works. Opus overestimated its own eyes network (expected 0.97 vs 0.834 actual).
